```{python}
#| include: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML
from twinfault_site import *

month = last_full_month()
prev = (pd.Timestamp(month + "-01") - pd.DateOffset(months=1)).strftime("%Y-%m")
m = sql(f"""
    with t as (
        select month, sum(transfers) as transfers,
               sum(transfers) filter (where route = 'via contract') / sum(transfers) as via_share
        from fct_daily_payments where month in ('{month}', '{prev}') group by month
    ),
    v as (
        select month, sum(volume) as volume
        from payments_value where month in ('{month}', '{prev}') group by month
    )
    select * from t join v using (month)
""").set_index("month")
cur, old = m.loc[month], m.loc[prev]
since = f"vs {month_label(prev)}"
```

## Row {height=420px}

```{python}
#| title: Daily transfers by token (7-day average)
daily = sql("""
    select date, token, sum(transfers) as transfers
    from fct_daily_payments group by all order by date
""")
fig = go.Figure()
for token in TOKENS:
    d = daily[daily.token == token].set_index("date").transfers.rolling(7, min_periods=1).mean()
    fig.add_scatter(x=d.index, y=d.values, name=token, mode="lines",
                    line=dict(color=TOKEN_COLORS[token], width=2),
                    hovertemplate="%{y:,.0f}")
fig.update_yaxes(tickformat="~s")
show(fig)
```

```{python}
#| title: Monthly value moved, by transfer size (outlier days left out, listed below)
bands = sql("""
    select month, amount_band, amount_band_order, sum(volume) as volume
    from payments_value group by all order by month, amount_band_order
""")
div, unit = money_unit(bands.groupby("month").volume.sum().max())
fig = go.Figure()
for band, color in zip(BANDS, BAND_COLORS):
    d = bands[bands.amount_band == band]
    fig.add_bar(x=d.month, y=d.volume / div, name=band, marker_color=color,
                hovertemplate="$%{y:,.2f}" + unit)
fig.update_layout(barmode="stack", bargap=0.15)
fig.update_yaxes(tickprefix="$", ticksuffix=unit, tickformat=",~r")
show(fig)
```

## Row {height=380px}

```{python}
#| title: Share of transfers moved inside another contract
via = sql("""
    select month, token,
           sum(transfers) filter (where route = 'via contract') / sum(transfers) as via_share
    from fct_daily_payments group by all order by month
""")
fig = go.Figure()
for token in TOKENS:
    d = via[via.token == token]
    fig.add_scatter(x=d.month, y=d.via_share, name=token, mode="lines+markers",
                    line=dict(color=TOKEN_COLORS[token], width=2), marker=dict(size=4),
                    hovertemplate="%{y:.1%}")
fig.update_yaxes(tickformat=".0%", rangemode="tozero")
show(fig)
```

```{python}
#| title: Share of transfers vs share of value, by size (last full month)
mix = sql(f"""
    select amount_band, amount_band_order,
           sum(transfers) / sum(sum(transfers)) over () as count_share,
           sum(volume) / sum(sum(volume)) over () as value_share
    from payments_value where month = '{month}'
    group by all order by amount_band_order
""")
fig = go.Figure()
for col, label in (("count_share", "Share of transfers"), ("value_share", "Share of value")):
    fig.add_bar(y=mix.amount_band, x=mix[col], name=label, orientation="h",
                marker_color="#8fb0e3" if col == "count_share" else "#1d3f8f",
                text=[f"{v:.0%}" for v in mix[col]], textposition="outside",
                hovertemplate="%{x:.1%}")
fig.update_layout(barmode="group", hovermode="y unified", bargap=0.25)
fig.update_xaxes(tickformat=".0%", range=[0, 1.12], showgrid=True, gridcolor=GRID)
fig.update_yaxes(autorange="reversed", tickfont=dict(color=INK))
show(fig)
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Monthly summary, last 12 months
table = sql("""
    with t as (
        select month, token, sum(transfers) as transfers from fct_daily_payments group by all
    ),
    v as (
        select month, token, sum(volume) as volume from payments_value group by all
    )
    select * from t left join v using (month, token)
    where month > (select strftime(max(date) - interval 12 month, '%Y-%m') from fct_daily_payments)
""")
wide = table.pivot(index="month", columns="token", values=["transfers", "volume"]).sort_index(ascending=False)
out = pd.DataFrame({"Month": [month_label(m_) for m_ in wide.index]})
for t in TOKENS:
    out[f"{t} transfers"] = [compact(v) if pd.notna(v) else "–" for v in wide[("transfers", t)]]
for t in TOKENS:
    out[f"{t} value"] = [compact(v, "$") if pd.notna(v) else "–" for v in wide[("volume", t)]]
HTML(html_table(out, numeric=tuple(out.columns[1:])))
```

## Row {height=250px}

```{python}
#| title: Days left out of the value figures
outliers = value_outliers()
if outliers.empty:
    out = HTML("<p>No day has a token's value moved above 1,000 times its median day, "
               "so nothing is left out.</p>")
else:
    reasons = [f'{r} (<a href="{u}" target="_blank">source</a>)' if r else "Not explained yet"
               for r, u in zip(outliers.reason, outliers.source)]
    table = pd.DataFrame({
        "Day": outliers.date.dt.strftime("%a %d %b %Y"),
        "Token": outliers.token,
        "Value moved": [compact(v, "$") for v in outliers.volume],
        "Times a median day": [f"{x:,.0f}×" for x in outliers.times_usual],
        "What happened": reasons,
    })
    out = HTML('<p class="note">A token-day is left out when its value moved is over 1,000 times '
               "that token's median day. Transfer counts still include it; only value figures "
               "on this page leave it out.</p>"
               + html_table(table, numeric=("Value moved", "Times a median day")))
out
```
